Notes_and_Tips: Avoid rice at dinner as per your preference.
When sweet cravings occur, eat a fruit first and wait 10 minutes before choosing another snack.
Reduce sweets, sugary drinks and packaged snacks to help manage blood sugar levels.
Aim for 15–20 minutes of morning sunlight daily. Regular morning sunlight can help support your sleep cycle, energy levels and overall wellbeing.
Continue playing sports regularly and include a 20–30 minute walk on non-sports days.
Drink at least 2.5–3 litres of water daily and try to eat your meals at consistent times.
